content:
Why Users are Looking for a DownSub Alternative

For years, DownSub has been a popular destination for downloading captions. However, as web development and YouTube's system evolved, users started experiencing several limitations:

  • Missing or Incorrect Timings: Many downloaders strip out critical timing metadata, making it impossible to sync subtitles with video editing software.
  • Cluttered Interface & Ads: Intrusive popups make it difficult to download files safely.
  • Limited Format Options: Finding SRT, WebVTT, and JSON formats in one clean interface is rare.

AudioTrackDown was designed from scratch to solve these issues, providing a seamless, high-speed, and secure subtitle extraction experience.

SRT, VTT, and JSON Formats Explained

Depending on what you need the subtitles for, different formats serve different purposes:

  • SRT (SubRip): The ultimate standard for media players (VLC, KMPlayer) and video editing suites (Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro).
  • VTT (WebVTT): The HTML5 standard for video players on the web. Ideal if you are building web apps or embedding captions on HTML5 video players.
  • JSON: Structured data output containing timecodes, speaker info, and transcript paragraphs. Essential for developers, AI prompt engineering, or importing text into custom translation tools.

How to Extract Subtitles with Timings using AudioTrackDown

  1. Copy the link: Copy the URL of any YouTube or Facebook video.
  2. Paste and extract: Head to AudioTrackDown, paste the link, select Subtitles, and hit Extract.
  3. Download: Find your language (the original language is highlighted with an Original badge at the top) and click SRT, VTT, or JSON to download instantly.
